name: CDC Eastern Creek 2

address.note: Campus address; Lot 2 DP 1159804 per SSD-10330 SEARs request.

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 17 ROBERTS ROAD EASTERN CREEK. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

developer.note: CDC fitted out/delivered the hall in an existing ex-HP building.

mw_it.note: 13 MW per CDC Oct 2019 deck; DCD Dec 2022 gives 20 MW (source 6) - may reflect later upgrade.

authority.note: Project approval 10_0142 granted by 'The then Minister for Planning' on 7 December 2010 for 'Construction and operation of data storage facility, comprising two data storage cells and associated infrastructure' (SSD-10330 Assessment Report, Table 1). Ongoing operation of this existing data centre remains under 10_0142. EC2 fit-out was done under private-certifier complying development certificates (see reference note).

pathway.note: Mod-2 Modification Report calls it 'the Part 3A approval, MP10_0142'.

reference.note: Covers the original ex-HP building with two data storage cells (inferred to be EC1 and EC2). CDC fit-out works used complying development certificates: CDC-19-00160 'Internal fit-out of the existing data storage facility' (private certifier, 19 Feb 2019) and CDC-21-00942 'CDC2 - Completion of Construction including fit out and essential services' (21 May 2021); link of these to EC2 not stated (sources 9, 10).

determined.note: Per DPIE/DPHI Assessment Reports for SSD-10330 and Mod-1; the Mod-2 Modification Report (Urbis) says 7 December 2012, which is taken to be an error (the building opened 2011-12). NSW portal page for MP10_0142 not found.

jobs_construction.note: No EC2-specific figures. The SSD-10330 jobs figures (448 construction, 10 operational) apply only to Buildings 4-6. CDC (ARN, Dec 2022): campus construction since 2018 'has created hundreds of jobs'.

construction_start.note: CDC works started after acquisition (14 Dec 2018); a complying development certificate for 'Internal fit-out of the existing data storage facility' (CDC-19-00160) was issued 19 Feb 2019 (source 9). Start date not stated.

construction_end.note: Planned 'final delivery date' per Oct 2019 deck; actual completion not confirmed. A certificate CDC-21-00942 'CDC2 - Completion of Construction including fit out and essential services' was issued 21 May 2021 (source 10); if 'CDC2' is EC2, works continued into 2021.

open_questions: scope: EC2 appears to be the second pre-existing 6,000 m2 data hall in the ex-HP/DXC building (shell built c.2011-12), fitted out/delivered by CDC in 2019 - confirm whether this counts as a facility completed after 2018-09-01.
does CDC-21-00942 'CDC2 - Completion of Construction' (May 2021) refer to EC2? If so completion may be 2021 rather than Dec 2019
